Thanks for the draft. A couple of quick legal edits before we surface these to Mondo:
- "SLA-backed latency targets" -> change to "latency targets backed by our Dedicated offering and SLAs" (avoids implying per-request guarantees for hosted tiers).

- For SOC 2 we can provide a summary and redacted attestations but not full raw reports until an NDA or audit request is in place. Mark the listing as "SOC 2 (summary available on request)."
